mismatches.status: LIVE — this runs on every company the editor opens
mismatches.expected: map-company.ts mapSector(): `const master = SECTORS.find(s => s.id === api.id)` — the API's sector `id` indexes the same taxonomy as the app's master list, so `sector_type` and `sector_name` can be resolved from it.
mismatches.actual: The API's sector ids are a DIFFERENT numbering. Of 22 distinct (id, name) pairs collected across 6 companies, only 7 agree with the master list. Six resolve to a DIFFERENT, REAL sector — the name is silently replaced with the wrong one.
evidence: id 174 — API "Travel & Tourism"      → master says "Hospitality"     (master id for Travel & Tourism is 155)
id 190 — API "Alternative Energy"    → master says "Enterprise IT"   (master id for Alternative Energy is 232)
id 208 — API "Engineering"           → master says "Fashion & Apparel" (master id for Engineering is 30)
id 226 — API "Hospitality"           → master has no id 226
id 247 — API "Clinical Trials"       → master says "Smart Cities"    (master id for Clinical Trials is 249)
id 253 — API "Smart Cities"          → master says "Regional"        (master id for Smart Cities is 247)
mismatches.impact: Wrong-but-plausible sector data written into CompanyFull.sectors, then cached in IndexedDB and shown in the editor as if it were the wire's own value. This is worse than a blank field: a blank is visibly missing, a wrong sector name is not. 6 of 22 corrupt, 9 fall through to the API's own `name` (correct), 7 happen to agree.
mismatches.fix: Resolve by NAME, not id: `SECTORS.find(s => s.sector_name === api.name) ?? SECTORS.find(s => s.id === api.id)`. Name-matching resolves 18 of the 22 against the master list versus 7 by id. src/lib/api/map-article.ts mapClassification() ALREADY matches by name — the two mappers disagree with each other.

mismatches.status: LIVE — and this app makes it worse than the public site does
mismatches.expected: Declared on both ApiCompanyListItem and ApiCompanyDetail, and mapped to CompanyFull.portal_username / portal_password.
mismatches.actual: Returned in plaintext on BOTH unauthenticated endpoints. Company 82 returns a real username/password pair; so does every row of /api/Companies.
mismatches.impact: The public site merely receives these. This app SYNCS ALL 9,606 COMPANIES and caches the mapped records — so a full sync writes 9,606 plaintext credential pairs into the browser's IndexedDB, where they persist across sessions and survive a page reload. Anything with access to the profile directory can read them. That is a materially larger exposure than the site's.
mismatches.fix: Backend must strip these from both DTOs. Until then this repo can drop them at the mapper (stop populating portal_username/portal_password from the wire) so they are at least never written to disk.
mismatches.where: backend — acnnewswire-api Companies DTO; locally src/lib/api/map-company.ts and src/lib/api/cache.ts

mismatches.expected: A second request per company editor load, for address, established/listed/employees, key people and socials. repository.ts issues fetchCompany + fetchCompanyDetails + fetchCompanyContacts in parallel.
mismatches.actual: Across 8 companies sampled, /details contributed exactly three things: `marketId: "1"` (a constant), the six social links (BYTE-IDENTICAL to the ones already on /api/Companies/{id}), and `pos1Desc/pos2Desc: "CEO"` with no matching name. Every address, telephone, facsimile, email, established, listed, employees, dunsNumber, otc and urlJa field was empty on all 8.
mismatches.impact: One of three HTTP requests per company load returns no information the first request did not already carry. The Company details tab and the address block have no data source at all — they are not broken, they are empty because the wire is empty.
mismatches.fix: Frontend can drop the call today and read socials off AC-PROFILE. But the real question is upstream: is the address/profile data absent from the dev database, or absent from this DTO? Worth asking the API team before deleting the call — it is the only endpoint that could ever carry an address.

mismatches.field: companyNameEN vs companyName — list and detail disagree
mismatches.expected: Modelled correctly: ApiCompanyListItem declares `companyNameEN`, ApiCompanyDetail declares `companyName` + `companyName2` and no `companyNameEN`.
mismatches.actual: CONFIRMED — the two projections really do use different key names for the same value, and neither carries the other's. The list has no `companyName`; the detail has no `companyNameEN`.
mismatches.impact: Not a bug here (the types already model it), but it is a landmine for anyone unifying the two shapes into one `Company` type: a naive merge of detail over list blanks `name_en`. Note also `companyName2` is an exact duplicate of `companyName` on every company sampled — it carries no second name.

mismatches.actual: 9,606 companies — 97 pages at Size=100 (Page=96 → 100 rows, Page=97 → 6, Page=98 → []).
mismatches.impact: None. MAX_PAGES=400 has ample headroom and the sweep stops on a short page. Recorded so the header comment can be corrected.

mismatches.field: error body shape is not uniform
mismatches.expected: One error contract across the API.
mismatches.actual: Two. Validation and 404 on /api/Articles, /api/Companies and /api/Articles/by-industry return RFC9110 problem+json ({type, title, status, errors, traceId}). /api/CompContacts with no params returns {"message":"Either companyId or contactId is required."}, and /api/Events/{id} returns {message, detail}.
mismatches.impact: ApiError only keeps the status, so nothing breaks today. But any future "show the server's reason" needs to handle both shapes.

mismatches.field: Size cap, Ord1 regex, 404 on unknown id, contacts paging
mismatches.expected: MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100; Ord1 validated against a regex; Page/Size/Sort1/Ord1 page the embedded contacts list.
mismatches.actual: All four verified. Size=101 → 400 with "Size must be between 1 and 100."; Ord1=BOGUS → 400; Sort1=Cont_Name&Ord1=DESC → 200; /api/Companies/99999999 → 404. The contacts default of Size=20 is real, and repository.ts already passes Size=100.
mismatches.impact: No action. Recorded because these are the assumptions most likely to be doubted during unification.
